summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage@38.1.5 presents itself as a fork of @verdaccio/local-storage but ships an install-time dropper. package.json declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs uses a locally installed `bun` binary if present, otherwise downloads a pinned Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then execs it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line Bun-cjs bundle with rotated string-array obfuscation (obfuscator.io shape: hex-numbered variable names, a `WV8StW` array-shift decoder, ~2000 mixed hex/string entries). The obfuscated payload runs unconditionally on `npm install` under a runtime the installer did not previously have. The exported library code in dist/index.js is a near-identical port of @verdaccio/local-storage, providing cover for the install-time execution path. The name closely resembles the legitimate @verdaccio/local-storage package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
